description: Audit coverage and API: instrument every remaining state-changing admin/staff/finance/grading/booking-override/closure/policy action with auditService.record inside the existing transaction (plan2.md section 6), thread `user` into services that lack it, add GET /api/v1/admin/audit and GET /api/v1/admin/audit/export.csv (Business Admin only, server-side filters and pagination, CSV formula-safe, audit.exported logged). Depends on FEAT-001 (audit_log table, auditModel, auditService, requestContext). Independent of the front end.
steps: Finish src/services/auditService.js: list(user, query) and exportCsv(user, query) (BA assertion, row mapping, facets, page/pageSize, 10 000 row export cap, filename audit-log-<today>.csv, record audit.exported); src/models/auditModel.js search/facets/export queries with escaped ILIKE and APP_TZ date bounds.

src/validators/admin.js auditQuery (strict, from<=to refine, group enum from auditService GROUPS); src/controllers/auditController.js; src/routes/admin/audit.routes.js (both routes requireAdminType('business'), validate query); mount in src/routes/admin/index.js; CSV headers like memberController.exportCsv (text/csv, attachment, no-store).

Instrument services with `await auditService.record(tx, user, {...})` inside the existing withTx, following the table in plan2.md section 6: memberService (patch -> member.updated/member.belt_changed with field names only for PII, message), followupService, paymentService (takePayment, collect, voidOrAdjust, reportMistake, requestRefund, decideRefund, lockDay, unlockDay, markReady, handOver), exceptionService, mcService, applicationService/registrationService (already started in FEAT-001: confirm), deskService (override booking, cancelBooking, setAttendance, submit), closureService (create, remove, cancelClass), policyService (all mutators), timetableService (create, update, remove), importService.decide, reportService (addIntervention, decideIntervention), notificationService.send, gradingService (submitResult, decideApplication, decidePromotion).

Thread `user` through the controllers/services that lacked it: src/controllers/businessController.js (policy*, timetableCreate/Patch, closureDelete, importDecide, decideIntervention) and src/controllers/financeController.js (equipmentReady, equipmentHandover) plus the matching service signatures; update every internal caller.
Every audit call uses the tx client (the harness runs DB_POOL_MAX=1). Summaries are human readable with no secrets; details hold ids/field names/before-after of non-PII values only (plan D10).

Quick API smoke with a throwaway script under .be-tmp/task2/: perform one action per audited family as BA/front desk/instructor and read the rows through GET /admin/audit; confirm front desk gets 403 and anonymous 401.
acceptance_criteria: Each action listed in plan2.md section 6 writes exactly one audit_log row in the same transaction (a failed/rolled-back action leaves no row) with the right action, actor id/role/admin type, entity type and id

GET /admin/audit returns { rows, total, page, pageSize, pages, facets } for BA; 401 anonymous; 403 for student, instructor and front desk; filters (from, to, actorId, group, action, entityType, entityId, q) and page/pageSize work; invalid params give 400
GET /admin/audit/export.csv returns text/csv with an attachment filename for BA only, escapes formula-leading cells, and logs audit.exported
No audit row or API response contains a bcrypt hash, JWT, password or temp password
Existing API behaviour is unchanged for non-audit responses (existing suites still pass once registration fixtures carry a password)
verification: node --check on every edited .js file under src/
Run the throwaway smoke script from the last step and confirm it passes

Start the harness DB and run: node .be-tmp/verify/api-admin-business.mjs and node .be-tmp/verify/api-admin-desk.mjs (fix only fixtures that need the new registration password / dropped tempPassword; do not weaken assertions)
findings: DONE. Verified: .be-tmp/task2/adhoc-feat002.mjs 104/104 (needs db.mjs running; covers 401/403 matrix, filters, pagination, 400s, one row per action for ~35 actions, no row on failed/forbidden action, CSV export + formula escaping + audit.exported, no secrets), adhoc-feat001 67/67, api-admin-business 315/315, api-admin-desk 273/273, api-instructor 53/53, api-auth 68/68, api-student 115/115, api-sqli 92/92, api-public 40/40. run-all.mjs and browser-* suites NOT run (front end is FEAT-003/004). PGlite stopped, no node processes left. API: GET /api/v1/admin/audit?from&to&actorId&group&action&entityType&entityId&q&page&pageSize (BA only; strict query; page default 1, pageSize default 25 max 100) -> { rows:[{id,at,actor:{id,name,role,adminType},action,group,entityType,entityId,summary,details,ip}], total, page, pageSize, pages, facets:{actors:[{id,name}],groups:[...],entityTypes:[...]} }, Cache-Control no-store. GET /api/v1/admin/audit/export.csv (same filters except page/pageSize; max 10 000 rows; columns Time (SGT), Actor ID, Actor, Role, Action, Entity type, Entity ID, Summary, Details; filename audit-log-<today>.csv; logs audit.exported with {filters,count}). 403 BUSINESS_ADMIN_ONLY for front desk, 403 for student/instructor, 401 anonymous. Note facets.groups lists only groups that already have rows (split_part of action). auditService now exports list, exportCsv; ACTIONS extended; validators/admin.js now requires auditService (for GROUPS) and exports auditQuery, auditExportQuery. NEW ACTIONS: member.updated/belt_changed/message_sent, followup.created/updated/attempt_logged/contact_logged, payment.collected/voided/adjusted/mistake_reported, refund.requested/decided, day.locked/unlocked, equipment.ready/handed_over, exception.raised/decided, mc.decision, booking.overridden/cancelled_by_staff, attendance.corrected/submitted, closure.created/deleted, class.cancelled, policy.updated/package_updated/rule_updated/template_created/template_updated/template_deleted, timetable.changed (details.change created|updated|removed), import.decided, intervention.added/decided, notification.sent, grading.result_submitted/application_decided/promotion_decided. SIGNATURE CHANGES (all gained a leading `user`): paymentService.markReady(user,id), handOver(user,id,body); policyService.update(user,settings), updatePackage(user,id,body), updateRule(user,id,body), createTemplate(user,body), updateTemplate(user,id,body), deleteTemplate(user,id); timetableService.create(user,body), update(user,id,body); closureService.remove(user,id); importService.decide(user,id,body); reportService.decideIntervention(user,id,body). Controllers businessController/financeController updated. DEVIATIONS/NOTES: (1) member.patch writes member.belt_changed (rank) and, if other fields changed, a separate member.updated row (so a patch with both gives 2 rows). followup.created for the bulk (no memberNo) path writes ONE row with count/ids (entityId null unless 1 created). exception decide that settles a linked extension writes only exception.decided (mcId in details), mcService.decide writes only mc.decision; mcService.apply itself is not audited. Instructor attendance marking (instructorService/attendanceService) and student actions are NOT audited (not in plan table). (2) Fixed a FEAT-001 bug: applicationModel.markStatus returned 500 on reject/request-info ('inconsistent types deduced for parameter $2'); now uses $2::varchar in both places. (3) Harness fixtures updated: api-admin-desk (APP-01 member signs in with password123, no tempPassword; desk registration sends password/confirmPassword Sunrise2026), api-admin-business (new staff must change temp password via POST /auth/change-password -> Sunrise2026 before BA-route checks; deactivated login uses Sunrise2026), api-public reg fixture carries password/confirmPassword. (4) summaries contain member/staff names and ids (not secrets). sanitize() drops any details key matching /pass|hash|token|secret|jwt|authorization|cookie|card|cvv|otp/i, so never name a details key like that (e.g. use titleLength, not token/otp). FOR FEAT-003/004: front end audit page should call GET /admin/audit (BA only; add ADMIN_PAGES entry and an audit.html like staff.html); browser-* suites still carry old expectations (34/36, registration without password, tempPassword in activatedModal) and are untouched; database/README.md still needs audit_log/new columns docs.
